title: pool build --redo keeps each refused model reply and its reason in the scratch directory
goal: A pool build --redo whose model reply is refused (unusable, only a path, too broad) writes the reply and the reason to a file outside the repository and names it, so the next step is chosen from evidence; in SP-7y6dk257 two paid redos were refused with the reply lost. Retrospective of SP-7y6dk257.
